topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Development of the self – positive self-concept
subtopics: Basic hygiene principles (integrated throughout the term)
Influence of adults and peers on self-concept
Personal successes as contributing factors to a positive self-concept
Action plan for continued positive self-concept formation

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Development of the self – giving and receiving feedback
subtopics: Giving feedback to and receiving feedback from peers and adults
Appropriate ways of giving and receiving positive and negative feedback

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Development of the self – coping with emotions
subtopics: Empathy, compassion, anger, disappointment and sadness
Skills to manage emotions in a positive way
Significance of friends in times of sadness, tragedy and change

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Development of the self – relationships
subtopics: Relationships with peers, older people and strangers
Safe and unsafe relationships and the benefits of safe relationships

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Formal assessment: written task
subtopics: Assignment/case study: design and make, on Term 1 work (30 marks)

topics.name: Physical Education: Movement sequences (gymnastics)
subtopics: Participation in movement sequences with consistency and control in smooth combinations of rotation, balance, locomotion and elevation (e.g. gymnastics sequences)

Locomotor and non-locomotor movement sequences exploring time (tempo, beats, meter)
Movement sequences exploring contrasts in time, levels, direction and force; mime using the five senses

subtopics: Vocal and singing warm-ups with South African songs in unison, canon and with actions

Western/African music examples: classify instruments by timbre and mood

topics.name: Creative Arts (Performing Arts): Formal practical assessment
subtopics: Rhythm patterns, notation and movement sequences exploring contrasts (40 marks, at least two of the three performing art forms)

topics.name: Creative Arts (Visual Arts): Create in 2D – images of self and others in the local environment
subtopics: Baseline assessment: art elements; pencil drawing 'A picture of me and my friends'
Complementary colour and emphasis (focal point) in own images; explore drawing and colour media

subtopics: Identify emphasis in images of the human body in action
Model human figures using texture, shape/form and emphasis in clay or other medium; spatial awareness; use of tools

sba: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Written task (30 marks)
Creative Arts: Performing Arts practical task (40 marks, rubric)

topics.name: Creative Arts (Visual Arts): Create in 2D – creative lettering and/or patternmaking
subtopics: Visual literacy: identify art elements and emphasis in lettering, patternmaking and African body adornment

topics.name: Creative Arts (Visual Arts): Formal practical assessment
subtopics: Create in 2D creative lettering and/or patternmaking OR create in 3D African body adornment (40 marks, rubric)

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Health and environmental responsibility – HIV and AIDS education

topics.name: Personal and Social Wellbeing: Formal assessment: controlled test
subtopics: Controlled test (30 marks): Section A matching columns, completing sentences and lists; Section B short open-ended, case-study and application questions, on Term 3 and 4 content
